description: Maritime transport - emergency ports WFS is a dataset listed in Geonorge, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kystverket / Geodatatjenesten. The service includes a description of the Norwegian Coastal Administration's pre-evaluated emergency port locations included in the Norwegian Coastal Administration's emergency response plans. These locations are deemed to be the most relevant locations in which to place ships in distress in order to avoid or limit acute contamination. Coverage: Kystverket / Geodatatjenesten. The publisher named on the listing is Kystverket / Geodatatjenesten. Its keywords include port of refuge, Oljevern, Nødhavn, Kystverket, Norwegian Coastal Administration, beaching. The listing shows 2017-10-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.norge.no/nlod/no/2.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geonorge.
